committee: Joint Select Committee on School Finance Recalibration
title: The purpose of this meeting is to consider proposed legislation regarding school resource officer grants and food service program reimbursements and receive information from the Wyoming Community College Commission regarding the implementation of the dual enrollment program created in the 2026 Budget Bill. The meeting will be held in person and remotely, with a live video stream available on the Legislature's Website (www.wyoleg.gov).
